method.sourceCheck: Compared train question semantics and answerText with deterministic SQL results over the SQLite benchmark.
method.validation: Generated and executed all 115 train and 36 dev SQL statements; all returned at least one row.

correctionGroups.defect: Annual-average top-and-bottom ranking was materialized as a year-end first-place row.
Annual single-day maximum and minimum was materialized as one year-end row.
Annual daily average, minimum, and maximum for one institution was materialized as an unrelated ranking row.
Month-over-month and year-over-year questions stored only one comparison row.
Top-three or bottom-three questions stored only one row.
Selected institution ranking stored the global first-place institution or an incorrect rank.
A winner within an explicitly named institution subset was materialized as a global rank result.
The last-place question stored the first-place institution.

adjudicationNotes.evidence: The question asks for the numeric maximum and minimum. The benchmark data maximum is 37.6 for ORG004 and the minimum is 25.51 for ORG010, while answerText labels them in reverse.
adjudicationNotes.decision: Gold SQL and structured rows follow the question's numeric maximum/minimum semantics. The source narrative remains an auditable known defect until its upstream workbook is corrected.

heldOutPolicy: No held-out result was used to choose or validate these train corrections.
